# forgejo_team (Resource)

Forgejo team resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    forgejo = {
      source = "svalabs/forgejo"
    }
  }
}

provider "forgejo" {
  host = "http://localhost:3000"
}

# Organization
resource "forgejo_organization" "owner" {
  name = "test_org"
}

# Team with full admin access
resource "forgejo_team" "admin_team" {
  organization = forgejo_organization.owner.name
  name         = "admin"
  description  = "Administrative team"
  is_admin     = true
}

# Team with granular permissions
resource "forgejo_team" "dev_team" {
  organization = forgejo_organization.owner.name
  name         = "developers"
  description  = "Development team"
  is_admin     = false

  permissions {
    code     = "write"
    issues   = "write"
    pulls    = "write"
    wiki     = "read"
    releases = "read"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `is_admin` (Boolean) Whether the team has full administrative access to all repositories. When true, uniform admin access is granted. When false, use the permissions block for fine-grained control.
- `name` (String) Name of the team.
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization the team belongs to.

### Optional

- `can_create_org_repo` (Boolean) Whether the team can create repositories in the organization.
- `description` (String) Description of the team.
- `includes_all_repositories` (Boolean) Whether the team has access to all repositories in the organization.
- `permissions` (Block, Optional) Repository access levels for the team. Required when is_admin=false. Each key represents a repository unit, with values specifying the access level ('none', 'read', 'write', 'admin'). Omitted keys default to 'none'. Ignored when is_admin=true. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the team.

<a id="nestedblock--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Optional:

- `actions` (String) Access level for actions (repo.actions).
- `code` (String) Access level for code (repo.code).
- `ext_issues` (String) Access level for external issues (repo.ext_issues).
- `ext_wiki` (String) Access level for external wiki (repo.ext_wiki).
- `issues` (String) Access level for issues (repo.issues).
- `packages` (String) Access level for packages (repo.packages).
- `projects` (String) Access level for projects (repo.projects).
- `pulls` (String) Access level for pull requests (repo.pulls).
- `releases` (String) Access level for releases (repo.releases).
- `wiki` (String) Access level for wiki (repo.wiki).
